layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Durophage diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish coiled ammonite shell made of smooth clay
The shell is a thick swirl of warm tan clay decorated with bold, rounded orange ridges
Smooth, chunky spiral geometry to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay ammonite shell sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate a shell-crushing diet for a children's matching game. No text.
